title: Dropping out for Atlantic City; Jack the Bear versus Eubie Blake
summary: He leaves school to follow Josephine to Atlantic City and decides Jack the Bear is no match for Eubie Blake.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So, anyhow, that summer she went to my school, and I was droppin' out of school regular, now. And so far, I was droppin' out of school, but my parents didn't know it because I was leavin' the house with my lunch. And they didn't know I was dropping out, but I was droppin' out, see. And so, that summer, I went with her to Atlantic City. Because that year, my father didn't go to Atlantic City. I went with her to Atlantic City. And that's where I met such fellows like Jack the Bear, playin' the piano. I thought he was good until after I had got another good look at Eubie Blake, I found that Jack the Bear was asleep on the piano stool.
Because Eubie was very good, you see, and he was getting better all the time.

So, now, Jack the Bear, she worked with Jack the Bear. That's when they first heard this piece, 'You Made Me Love You, I Didn't Want to Do It'. Well, Jack the Bear was very good. He was good for hokum, but he wasn't in no comparison with Eubie Blake.
